init_agent: init the GeneraticAgent and start its run loop in a daemon thread, returning the agent instance
render_sidebar_controls: render the sidebar with LLM switching, abort, tool re-injection, desktop pet launch, and autonomous action toggle buttons
fold_turns_response: fold multi-turn LLM output text into segments with extractable summary titles for collapsible display
render_segments_stream: render fold and text segments as Streamlit expanders and markdown with optional cursor suffix
stream_agent_response: stream agent backend responses for a given prompt, yielding partial text chunks via a display queue
